summary: Experience the art of bathing with the Nur Freestanding Bath—crafted from luxurious MarmoTech for superior warmth and comfort. Designed to pair seamlessly with the Nur Basins and Milady Toilet, it’s the perfect centrepiece for a refined bathroom.
title: The Nur Bath - Bathing, Perfected
bodyHtml:
The Nur Bath in MarmoTech Matte White - 1600 x 800 x 550

Say hello to Nur

Designed to mirror the trademark curves of our Nur collection, The Nur Bath is the ultimate hero piece for your space, marked by a sophisticated ‘floating’ effect thanks to its sensuous curves above a subtle underskirt.

Available in both gloss white and semi-gloss white, the Nur bath is simply the epitome of refined design through reduced details.


The Nur Bath features Overflow with Matching Plug & Waste Included

Seamless Pairing for a Cohesive Bathroom Aesthetic

For a fully harmonised bathroom, the Nur Bath pairs effortlessly with our Nur Basins and the timeless Milady Toilet Range.

Together, they create a fluid, organic aesthetic that enhances any contemporary space with a sense of understated luxury.


Nur 80 Bench Basin & Milady Back to Wall Suite - Part of Collection Organic

Crafted for Comfort & Performance

Made from MarmoTech, a premium stone composite that is 100% silica-free, the Nur Bath offers more than just visual elegance. Its surface quickly warms to the touch and efficiently retains heat, delivering a luxurious bathing experience every time.

Effortless Immersion

Each bath is meticulously crafted to the highest standards of quality and durability, featuring an included overflow and matching plug & waste for seamless installation and peace of mind.

Redefine relaxation with the Nur Freestanding Bath—the perfect fusion of form, function, and indulgence.
